content:
Rina Gomez: Heads-up: vendor pen-test (InsightSecure) slated Thu 09:00-13:00 PT. Opening thread for scope, RBAC changes, KMS access pattern, and retest SLA.
Evan Park: ack. Scope? inference API, model serving control plane, telemetry sink?
Rina Gomez: yes to those three. Exclude customer DBs and billing. I'll upload assessor manifest to intake.
Theo Marsh: RBAC: ephemeral-assessor role only. Recommend STS duration 2h, explicit deny for iam:*, kms:CreateGrant, s3:PutObject.
Evan Park: KMS: prefer proxy decryptor pattern. Stand up ephemeral decryptor service with short-lived grant instead of giving assessors direct Decrypt.
Rina Gomez: Agreed. Add EncryptionContext tag with assessor id on the grant and audit markers at session start/end.
Theo Marsh: Ops: set auditstream sampling to 100% for the window and extend retention to 90 days. @oncall can you schedule snapshot at 08:30?
oncall: Yes. I'll snapshot and confirm. Need final bucket names and exact CIDR allowlist.
Evan Park: Evidence delivery via presigned URLs only. No live DB queries. Also publish allowed CIDRs and user agents.
Rina Gomez: Retest policy: critical -> emergency retest within 72h if ops available. High -> next scheduled retest slot in monthly cycle. We'll document in intake.
Theo Marsh: Owners: runtime fixes -> Theo. Infra/KMS/S3 -> Evan. Rina will be assessor liaison and escalation.
ops-bot: Reminder: upload assessor list and allowed CIDRs to /security/pen-tests/1729876543/ by EOD Tue.
Rina Gomez: Dry-run request: Wed 10:00 PT smoke tests (3 masked /v1/generate calls). Add to calendar?
oncall: Added. I'll post snapshot command output after run.
Evan Park: I'll drop minimal IAM policy + KMS grant template in the intake doc.
Rina Gomez: Cool. If blockers appear during dry-run, flag here. :thumbsup:
